scope: Reference-only visual inspection; no source photographic assets included in scene

references.title: Field main and upper floor plan
references.observations: Long north–south central hall, north/south entrances, side galleries and upper balcony. Publication September 2022; current official maps page linked this file.

references.title: Field Stanley Hall event photograph
references.observations: Actually inspected Ionic columns, upper arches, balcony rail, large paving blocks, sauropod/elephants. Event blue/pink illumination not adopted as permanent lighting.

references.title: Field south facade
references.observations: Triangular pediment and corner ornaments, broad side wings; corrected initial flat attic assumption.

references.title: Field frontal portico
references.observations: Four Ionic shafts between broad plain antae, flanking caryatid porches, pediment. Corrected initial eight-shaft inference.

references.title: Museum Campus aerial
references.observations: Field rectangle and broad stairs, Shedd octagon and lake-facing crescent, shoreline relationship. Acquisition date unknown; used OSM for ground placement.

references.title: Shedd facade conservation profile
references.observations: Actually viewed Doric shafts and marble facade, pediment/cornice, aquatic relief details; source describes original octagonal rotunda and cardinal wings.

references.title: Shedd current visitor plan
references.observations: Actually viewed exploded levels and Main Entry beside south circular ticketing/dropoff. July 21, 2026 poster. Ground entrance, main-level rotunda, lower/underwater oceanarium levels. Modeled ramp is interpretive.

references.title: Shedd current Wonder of Water hero
references.observations: Parent actually viewed two curved tanks, green freshwater and blue coral, central passage, double-lobed gold scalloped crown, pale rotunda and glazed dome. Not the former single Caribbean Reef tank.

references.title: Oceanarium designer interior photo
references.observations: Actually viewed exposed trussed ceiling and fixtures, stone seating terraces, rock-framed shore, pool and glass rail; Space Haus owner-team designer portfolio,2009 project.

references.title: Shedd west entrance at night
references.observations: Photographer Diego Delso,October 21, 2012. Warm off-white column/pediment washing; darker stairs, globe lamps, cool glazing behind shafts. Viewed only; no asset downloaded.

references.title: Field Museum at night
references.observations: Brian Cormack photograph June 25, 2025. Actually viewed warm-white portico/column lighting and brighter pediment, dark stairs, temporary pink wing wash. Permanent reconstruction uses warm-white lighting; no image downloaded.

references.title: Close aerial of Shedd south entrance and Museum Campus Cafe
references.observations: Two low rounded white pavilion roofs frame the circular Man with Fish plaza. The cafe is a narrow diagonal low roof beside the southwest dropoff. OSM relation 18999713 matches the southwest ticket pavilion; way 445721198 is the cafe. Image acquisition date unknown; roof height cannot be measured reliably from this aerial.

references.title: Built Shedd ticket pavilion at night, engineer presentation
references.observations: Photo credited to VDT / Carolyn Everett in Thornton Tomasetti engineer Melissa Bayer's 2025 SEAOI presentation. Curved glass ticket pavilion has one tall storey, a thin cream rounded overhanging roof, glazed columns and mullions, warm ceiling illumination and bright ticket kiosks. Approximate 4–5m roof height is an inference from door/kiosk scale, not a published dimension.
